resources.string: With this on, the search boxes in the clipboard, notes, snippets, emoji and sticker panels also show what matches the meaning of your words, after the usual matches. "groceries" finds the note "Buy milk, eggs and bread", and "বিড়াল" finds 🐈. It works in more than 100 languages.\n\nThe model is EmbeddingGemma 2 by Google. It is downloaded once and runs on this phone. What you search and what it searches never leave the phone. While the model is in use it takes about 350 MB of memory, in a process apart from the keyboard, and it lets that memory go after a few minutes.
Also find things by what they mean, not only by the letters typed

Text finds clips, notes, snippets and emoji by meaning. Text and pictures also finds your own stickers and saved GIFs by what they show, and is a larger download. Off keeps search as it was and downloads nothing.
The model is not downloaded yet. Search works as before until it is.
Ready. The keyboard adds matches by meaning as it learns your clips, notes and snippets, a few at a time in the background.
Stickers without keywords get some from what they show, so they come up while you type
Delete the search model? Search by meaning stops until you download it again.
The search model is a large download.
